name: Pedro MC Fernandes
headline: Experienced Product Designer | Systems Thinker | Enterprise 0→1 Strategy & Code-Shipping | 18+ Years Building & Scaling
summary:
I'm a systems-thinking product designer who transforms stagnating products into growth engines by fixing ecosystems, not just interfaces.

I operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, defining a vision that influences executive roadmaps while shipping production code that helps scale teams and operations. My specialty is diagnosing why products underperform, then building the frameworks and systems that unlock their potential.

At Percona, I helped upkeep and then amplify product adoption growth by identifying the underlying problems, beyond UI cosmetics, and systematizing core, scalable fixes that slowly start to scaffold. At Farfetch, I shifted sustainability from being costly to being a business opportunity by revealing how shopping discovery barriers created vicious cycles.

I thrive in ambiguous 0→1 spaces where I can own strategy as well as delivery, building design systems that become force multipliers for teams.
